scenes.setting: Casing the study exhibit: elimination logic says only the 'manuscript of creativity' is valuable enough for Roselle's joke — its emperor-portrait bookmark may be the second Card of Blasphemy; security is light with the Devil hunt on, and the washroom recon completes the floor plan
scenes.text_anchor: There's only one bookmark in the entire exhibition hall that requires verification.

scenes.setting: Home scheming with image intact: Klein prays to himself as 'the adorer' — touch the bookmark, nick it, whisper 'Pirate King' in Hermes, 500 pounds — then above the fog forwards the mosaicked plea to Miss Justice without Mr. Fool saying a word
scenes.text_anchor: He decided to pass on the image and voice of his “adorer's” plea directly to Miss Justice.
